Draconian Teacher
It's good to know that we are protected against them. This inn is my life and livelihood, if it went down... well, I would go down with it.
The meteors from the moon are a hindrance to our efforts to establish civilization here!
A [color=770000]Bombardment Shield[/color] should be able to protect us!
Perfect! Now we don't have to worry about meteors!
What's this? [item=wyrm]s made of steel? Have you tried using an [item=alter_gem] on one?
This [item=steel_wyrm_helm] is amazing! Who knew that the magic of [item=alter_gem]s could be used on human technology!
What? You showed a [item=dragon_armor] to some scientists? I must go and confirm that they are using such powerful magic responsibly!
So scientists created these [item=steel_wyrm]s? I must speak with them at once!
Cyborg augmentation… magical infusion… combined strengths… [font=drachenklaue]balderdash[/font]...
This is amazing! I wish I'd had this technology at my disposal earlier!
Of course, I must ask the [object=professor] to make a few modifications.
So, they have attacked us at last. Don't worry about the others, there is a cave I prepared in anticipation of this event.
With the [color=770000]Bombardment Shield[/color], however, this cave is redundant. I will stay here to continue my research.
So, they have attacked us at last. The [color=770000]Bombardment Shield[/color] will protect us, for now.
What are you doing here? The [item=ship_parts] are to the West, and we need them to further our research!
Now that we have [item=ship_parts], we need new magic to investigate! You should head East and explore more!
I feel like there is more we can do with [item=mecha_dragon]s, but we will need to learn more about science and magic to do so...
I feel like there is more we can do with [item=mecha_dragon]s, but we will need to repair the [color=770000][tile=escort_fighter.ico] Fighter Escort[/color] to do so...
I feel like there is more we can do with [item=mecha_dragon]s, but we will need to evolve a [color=770000][tile=dragon_ship.ico] Dragon Ship[/color] to do so...
This new line of research, inspired by the [item=dragon_armor] has incredible potential! Tell us: what magic turned this [item=adult_dragon] into armor?
An [item=alter_gem]? Try combining one with a [item=steel_wyrm] and see what happens!
This [item=steel_wyrm_helm] is incredible! Tell us: where did you learn this power?
An [object=alchemist] you say? Imagine what we could do if we worked together!
The signal the [color=770000]Old One[/color] sent when it was defeated does not bode well for us.
We have devised an ingenious way to stop the bombardment from destroying what is left of this planet!
Although we persevered through the first wave of attack, we must prepare for the second!
By using the abilities of the [item=mecha_dragon], we should be able to create a [color=770000]Bombardment Shield[/color]!
Bring a [item=mecha_dragon], along with a few other materials, to the highest mountain. Contact us once you have the materials!
You have the materials for the shield? Then we must construct it at once!
Marvelous! Now we don't need to worry about them bombarding us!
It's good to see the [color=770000]Bombardment Shield[/color] holding. Without it, we might have had to do something rash, like taking down the bomber ourselves!
What better weapons to research than the very ones they used against us: The dragons!
The [item=mecha_dragon] was just the beginning! The next step is to create cyborg spaceships!
Now that you have evolved the [color=770000]Mecha Dragon Ship[/color], we have added weapons for it to our store. As always, the funds go to more research!
It is a shame that the [object=alchemist] was killed. He would have been very useful for helping us with our research! However, we've been examining his notes and the possibilities are promising.
Our research into the combination of magic and science has proved fruitful!
With the [color=770000]Mobile Research Lab[/color] at our disposal, we have completed some amazing research!
The [object=mirrows]' sacrifice was heroic. Despite their absence, I have been able to make some progress!

By using an [item=evo_gem] on a [item=steel_wyrm], you should be able to create a [item=mecha_dragon]! This powerful dragon is fueled by [tile=power] [color=444400]Power[/color] instead of [item=steak]!
This is just the beginning. With more time and resources, think of what we can accomplish by infusing technology with magic!!

Using technology from the [color=770000][tile=escort_fighter.ico] Fighter Escort[/color] and the powerful evolution magic used to create [color=770000][tile=dragon_ship.ico] Dragon Ships[/color], we should be able to create an entirely new class of ship!
By using the magic of the [color=770000]Dragon Factory[/color] on a [item=mecha_dragon], we can make a [color=770000]Mecha Dragon Ship[/color]!

Now that you are able to translate the alien language and have gained access to their HQ, you should look around and see if you can talk to any of the evolved dragons there!
As you know, I was created using [item=evo_gem]s. What are [item=evo_gem]s? They are an incredible crystal-like stone that can channel power directly from the spirit realm.
The [item=power_core]s fueling me are amazing! I can produce endless power without needing to consume endless [item=steak]!
The fusion of technology and magic that created me means I cannot use normal weapons.
By fusing your human weapons with magical materials, you should be able to create something worthy of my greatness.
Recipes for [item=mecha_dragon_ship.gun] and [item=mecha_dragon_ship.cannon] added to the [color=770000]Forge[/color].
The [object=mirrows] built a shield? Well, I'll go back to the surface then!
We are safe from their attacks?! Then it’s back to the open skies and seas for me! I’ll see you topside!
We are safe from their attacks?! Then let’s get out of this cave! I can’t wait to see the sun again!
This planet is safe, but if humanity is to survive, we need to bring all the survivors together and hope there’s enough of us left that we won’t die out!
What's this? A [item=mecha_dragon]?! All of our research, and you go and create something that far surpasses it! Well, we will get to work on further uses for this amazing creature!
So, you are the one who discovered the secret of this [item=dragon_armor]!
So, you are the ones who created these [item=steel_wyrm]s!
I propose that we work together, so that we can pool our knowledge and research fusions of magic and science!
That sounds like a good idea. Come to our lab and we can begin our research!
If only there was some way to reach the [color=770000]Alien HQ[/color] - I'm sure we could find some useful research materials there!
We need some way to communicate with the creatures on the [color=770000]Alien HQ[/color]. I wonder if there's some magical means they use to communicate?
Awesome job - the seas are finally safe again! If only the inn was still standing, I could take you out for drinks to celebrate. He was an awful guy, but I'll miss Mortimer.
I have been examining the [color=770000]Mecha Dragon Ship[/color], and I have discovered something fascinating. Dragons appear to have some knowledge coded into their DNA!

This dragon believes that the gas giant Unoiks 428d is actually a terrestrial planet! I think that the [color=770000]Mecha Dragon Ship[/color] has some special abilities that will allow it to find out what's really there.
Intriguing! An entire world, hidden from outside eyes? Whatever could be hiding there? You should investigate the planet further!

I have been researching further fusions of magic and science. My current project is a device capable of disabling the alien ships' shields. To complete it, I need a material more powerful than what we currently have access to.

I have reason to believe that there is some material, some form of magical [item=exotic_matter], that fits my specifications. Could you go to the [color=770000]Hidden World[/color] and investigate? The [object=draconian_teacher] might know more about it.
Remarkable! This [item=exotic_gas] you discovered is even more powerful than [item=exotic_matter]! I will be working with the [object=draconian_teacher] to unlock its full potential!
With it, the weapon is complete! Due to its nature, it can only be installed on the [color=770000]Mecha Dragon Ship[/color].
Evolve it from the equipment menu, and use [key=hotkey8] to fire it!
Now that the war against them is won, I am interested in studying their magic - and what we can do by fusing that magic with human technology!
Using the evolution magic used to create [color=770000][tile=dragon_ship.ico] Dragon Ships[/color], along with the technology from this lab, we can create a new ship!
The [object=draconian_teacher] and I have been hard at work researching a way to end this war peacefully, and we have just made a breakthrough! You should go to the Hidden World at once!
CaptAIn here! We must launch an assault at once! If the enemy grows any stronger, we will never be able to defeat them!
That won't be neccesary! I have found a solution.
We don't have time for idle talk! We must prepare our attack now!
What you just saw was only a fraction of their army! We can never win against their full strength. But there is another option: A truce.
A truce!? This is treason! Nonsense! They destroyed humanity!
War against them is futile. We will lose. Humanity's only chance is this truce. I have already convinced their leader to consider a treaty.

You have? Well, that changes things. On behalf of the remaining survivors of humanity, I will negotiate the terms of a peace treaty. However, I still believe they must be brought to justice for their actions!

Yet, somehow you lived on - including that terrible hooded man, digging away at our homeworld and our secrets. But never would I have guessed that not only would you survive, but you would muster an army capable of destroying us!
To think... that mere humans could defeat the accumulated power and knowledge of centuries. What will become of my race now that we are outdone?
There is another option, one that could end well for both our races. Humanity has agreed to negotiate a peace treaty.
You are an idealist. Realistically, there is little hope of our two civilizations coexisting. However, I will consider the possibility and take part in these negotiations.

You are fortunate I did not see through your illusions until after the treaty was signed. Do not worry - I will not break the treaty, but I am embarrassed that I did not see through it until it was too late.
But, do not pat yourself on the back just yet, for I fear this truce will not be long lived. But, until it ends, you are welcome here.
You must have great prowess in magic to have awoken me. Whatever you did broke the seal I had placed on this planet, so now anyone may enter or leave at will.
I am a Teacher, one of the last of my kind. I sealed myself here, in stasis, long ago. But that is a story for another time.
Your prowess in magic - it must have led you to conflict. Have you heard of those who are the descendants of the Old Ones?
Oh my. An entire planet destroyed? Unimaginable. We Teachers should have known things would come to this.
Oh my. What a story. Worlds destroyed. Unimaginable tragedy. I wonder if either of your races will ever be able to rebuild.

As a Teacher, it is my duty to promote peace and knowledge. I will help you, but you must promise me this: You will do all you can to avoid further conflict with them. Peace may yet still be an option.
For now, there is nothing I can help you with. Let me regain some strength. Return here if you discover anything that might be of use in this conflict.
You are in search of a new material? Well, it might be prudent to explore this planet. The creatures here have become suffused with its immense magical power!
[item=exotic_gas]! Incredible! This material appears to have great potential for magical suffusion.
Try enchanting an [item=exo_sword] at a [color=770000]Forge[/color]!
What would you like to know?
Ask about the Teachers
Ask about Them
Ask about the Dishonored One
Ask about Exotic Gas
We created the monoliths you have seen - like the one you used to awaken me.
Our main task was to teach - we spread magical knowledge to any who would receive it, in the interest of bettering all.
However, there were some, like the Dishonored One, who opposed this.
The aliens who destroyed your homeworld... Quite the story.
They were always eager to learn from our teachings. At first, we took this as a good sign. However, as time passed, their civilization grew ever more distant from the open sharing we promoted.
I believe, at heart, they are afraid. Alone, they can only wield small amounts of magic. It is only through others that they can achieve great power. This is why they enslaved the dragons.
This must also be why they attacked humanity. They sensed in you the possibility to wield more magical power than they could. This fear is their secret weakness, and the key to their downfall.
The Dishonored One was one of us - a Teacher.
Ever tolerant, it took a long time for us to act. But eventually, we cast him out of our ranks and named him the Dishonored One.
The Dishonored One sneered at us, calling us fools and assuring us that he would have the last laugh. After this, he disappeared.
After many years of peace, none expected the flood. The waters rose and rose, drowning villages and killing indiscriminately. We did everything in our power to stop the flood, but we could not.
We knew we had to stop the Dishonored One. We banded together and fought him at the summit of the tallest mountain, where the waters had not yet reached.
The battle raged for weeks, and drained our planet’s vast amount of magic. With the supply of magic running thin, survival became a challenge.
The Dishonored One survived by going into a deep slumber, and I did the same, in the hopes that I would be awakened by someone who could help restore what was lost.
This planet has vast magical power, almost as much as my homeworld. Everything here has become suffused with it, including the [item=exotic_matter] normally found on other planets!
The creatures here have also become suffused with its energy. They are dangerous and untameable!
By using [item=exotic_gas] as a conduit for magical energy, we can fuse human technology and ancient magic together!

The [object=professor] and I have been working on a plan to avoid further conflict between Humanity and the descendants of the Old Ones - the race you call 'them.' After much research, we have a plan: A [color=770000]Holographic Projector[/color]!
With this powerful device, we can create illusions real enough to convince both sides that there is no possible outcome but mutual destruction.

This will not be easy to build. We will bind technology to a [item=hq_factory_seed] using [item=exotic_gas]. This world has enough magical energy to sustain the projector, but you will need to jumpstart the process with [item=exotic_gas].
You have the materials? Then it is time to end this war, once and for all!

The [color=770000]Holographic Projector[/color] is complete! In order for it to create realistic illusions, you will need to bring a [color=770000][tile=dragon_cruiser.ico] Dragon Cruiser[/color] and an [item=exo_fighter] to this world.
When you are ready, charge and activate the projector.
Congratulations! We still have a long road ahead to ensure lasting peace, but the hard part is over. At last, there will once again be harmony among the stars!
It is fantastic to see dragonkind flourishing after so many millenia of servitude!
It is a shame that no other Teachers survived. I'm not sure what to do with the rest of my days...
It is wonderful to know another Teacher remains alive! With time, we should be able to undo some of the harm that they brought upon the multitude of civilizations that we used to aid!
Now that the dragons are free, we thought it would be a good idea to create a sanctuary for them here!
Since you freed them, it is your choice. Do you want the dragons to live here, and start anew, or stay under the control of them?
Create Sanctuary
Leave with Them
Let this be the first step in repairing the damage they have done!
It is tragic that the [object=research] was destroyed. Without the [object=professor], all of my research has stalled.

A [item=staff] that allows you to cast spells with [tile=stamina] [color=006600]Stamina[/color]? With [item=exotic_gas], you should be able to make a staff that uses [tile=power] [color=444400]Power[/color] instead!
Recipe for [item=battery_staff] added to the [color=770000]HQ Library[/color].
A sanctuary for dragons? I will head there immediately!
This is better than I have dreamed for millenia! A whole world dedicated to the renewal of dragonkind! Magnificent!
Type "/help" for a list of commands.
